keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Ipswich Town 0, Bournemouth 1. Evanilson (Bournemouth) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom left corner.
Adam Smith (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Julio Enciso (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card.
Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Ipswich Town 0, Bournemouth 1.
Own Goal by Leif Davis, Ipswich Town. Ipswich Town 0, Bournemouth 2.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Jack Clarke replaces Jaden Philogene.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Zian Flemming replaces Emersonn.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Abdul Fatawu replaces Daizen Maeda.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Lewis Cook replaces Ryan Christie.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Junior Kroupi replaces Justin Kluivert.
Goal! Ipswich Town 1, Bournemouth 2. Jack Clarke (Ipswich Town) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Bafodé Diakité replaces Adam Smith.
Delay in match because of an injury Bafodé Diakité (Bournemouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Ipswich Town. Chuba Akpom replaces Florentino.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Álvaro Rodríguez replaces Evanilson.
Substitution, Bournemouth. Amine Adli replaces Rayan.
António Silva (Bournemouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Zian Flemming (Ipswich Town) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half ends, Ipswich Town 1, Bournemouth 2.
